Eliminate an infamous [[Stone Summit]] taskmaster and his mounted unit.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find and destroy [[Krak Flamewhip]]'s elite cavalry unit in [[Jaga Moraine]].
* See [[Undrath Blastrock]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 200 [[Deldrimor_rank|Dwarf reputation points]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* {{skill icon|"Don't Trip!"}}

==Walkthrough==
Start from [[Sifhalla]]. Leave out through the portal and head east. Krak Flamwhip and his party of two [[Stone Summit Arcanist]]s and four [[Stone Summit Herder]]s [[patrol]] counter-clockwise around the southwest area of the zone.  If you have difficulty finding them, try staying put near the resurrection shrine of [[Gunnleif]] at the middle of the map and let the patrol come to you. Kill the entire patrol, then return to Undrath for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Undrath Blastrock'''
:''"'''Krak Flamewhip''', a notoriously cruel Stone Summit Dwarf, has mobilized a mounted unit that has been wreakin' havoc on us [[Deldrimor]]. He and his stooges have been sighted in '''Jaga Moraine'''. You'd be doin' us a heck of a favor if ya put a '''hurtin'''' on 'em."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll flamewhip him good.
|decline = I'd rather put my feet up.
|ask = Find '''Krak Flamewhip''' and his cavalry unit in '''Jaga Moraine''' and slay them! 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Undrath Blastrock'''
:''"So you put out Flamewhip's fire, eh? If you were two feet shorter I'd kiss ya! [[Budger Blackpowder|Budger]]'ll be especially thrilled. He's got a long, unpleasant history with Krak. We'll be celebratin' tonight!"''

== Notes ==
* You can save time by combining this quest with [[A Hunter's Pride]], [[Prenuptial Disagreement]], and [[Anything You Can Do]].
